- Professional legal counsel (Hunton Andrews Kurth LLP) provides favorable legal opinion on the transaction

- Cross-border corporate reorganization introduces execution complexity and potential regulatory risks, though mitigated by professional legal structuring
- Limited visibility into financial performance, covenant compliance metrics, or underlying business fundamentals
